llm_raw_reply: Yes Bank Paisabazaar PaisaSave looks like the best pick you can actually apply for – it saves about ₹12,000 a year and has no joining fee. The top‑ranked Axis Burgundy Magnus saves a bit more (₹18,600) but it’s invitation‑only, so you can’t get it directly. The Axis SpiceJet Voyage is another option with roughly ₹10.6 k savings, but the PaisaSave’s free fee makes it the easier choice.
final_reply: Yes Bank Paisabazaar PaisaSave looks like the best pick you can actually apply for – it saves about ₹12,000 a year and has no joining fee.
